investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For offence of fraudulent evasion of duty see section 170 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
(ii) See H9483, H9484 and H9485 for offences relating to drugs of Classes A, B and C.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY:If the drug is found to be Class A or Class B, six months imprisonment and/or a penalty of £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
If the drug is found to be Class C, three months imprisonment and/or a penalty of five hundred pounds or three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.

INDICTMENT: If the drug is found to be Class A, imprisonment for life and/or a fine. If the drug is found to be Class B, 14 years imprisonment and/or a fine. Class C, three months imprisonment and/or a penalty of five hundred pounds or three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
